response.sql: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS side_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.dealedge IN ('Buy', 'Sell') GROUP BY o.dealedge), side_average AS (SELECT AVG(side_count) AS average_count FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(sc.side_count) AS total_count, AVG(sc.side_count - sa.average_count) AS average_excess FROM side_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN side_average AS sa WHERE sc.side_count > sa.average_count

assumptions.assumption: The average is calculated across sides with at least one matched risk/margin record.

alternatives.interpretation: Include both Buy and Sell in the average, assigning a count of zero to a side with no matched records.
alternatives.sql: WITH sides(side) AS (VALUES ('Buy'), ('Sell')), side_counts AS (SELECT s.side, COUNT(o.orderspivot) AS side_count FROM sides AS s LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.dealedge = s.side LEFT JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE r.riskandmarginpivot IS NOT NULL OR o.orderspivot IS NULL GROUP BY s.side), side_average AS (SELECT AVG(side_count) AS average_count FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(sc.side_count) AS total_count, AVG(sc.side_count - sa.average_count) AS average_excess FROM side_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN side_average AS sa WHERE sc.side_count > sa.average_count
